name: Himetsubaki Haruki
source: He loves fashion and dreams of becoming a student of designer Osasa Kaoru. Thus he is attending the school where Osasa Kaoru teaches in. Thinking the school is an all-girls school, he goes to school as girl. But now the school has changed to an all-boys school. His pretty face made him get assaulted by boys. At first Haruki isn't interested in men, but day by day slowly he enjoys taking womanly pleasure. He starts to awaken pleasure as a trap.
